source_frontmatter.name: github-social-preview
source_frontmatter.description: Generates a professional GitHub repository social preview image sized 1280x640 pixels as a JPG under 1 MB. Always trigger immediately when the user's message starts with "gsp". Also trigger on "generate github social preview", "create repo preview image", or any request to generate a social preview or OG image for a GitHub repository.

transformations.Use the `WebFetch` tool to read the GitH: Use an available, authorized web retrieval tool to read the GitHub repository page. If retrieval is unavailable, ask for the repository content; do not invent it.
transformations.- If still over 1 MB at quality 55: scal:
- Never resize for compression: preserve exactly 1280x640. If quality 40 still cannot produce fewer than 1,000,000 bytes, fail clearly and ask to simplify the artwork; do not deliver an oversized or resized image.
- Decode the saved JPEG and report its actual dimensions, format and byte count, not the original canvas constants.
transformations.| Image over 1 MB after quality 55 | Sca: | Image at least 1,000,000 bytes after quality 40 | Fail without replacing the destination; simplify artwork, never resize |
